post_change_qc.js.notes: Runs and produces valid output but exits with code 1 (overall: FAIL). Governance guard tests pass (54/54), parse validation passes, QID counts pass for Packs A-D (500/500 each). Failure is solely due to Pack E: expected=500 but actual=545 — a stale expected-count constant that doesn't account for the 40-item R-series supplement (P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40) plus some additional items. Not a script logic defect, but the stale expected count prevents clean exit.

Flags 2 items total: 1 simple relabel candidate (P1-EC-019, Moderate→Easy) and 1 rewrite-required candidate (P1-ED-068). Produces structured output to scripts/output/dl031_classification.json. No errors or warnings.

rebuild_baselines.js.notes: Runs cleanly in --dry-run mode, exit code 0. Correctly computes SHA-256 hashes for 17 runtime-critical files (app.js, index_updated.html, styles.css, 5 MCQ packs, 3 case_pack files, 2 may-* files, governance-guard.js, test_governance_guard.js, ExplanationValidator.js, build_master_registry.js). Certified pool counts are correct (2441/2545 = 95.9%). DEFECT: All 3 case_pack files report 'Items: -1' — the item-counting logic fails on the case file format. The script references case_pack_1/2/3_corrected.js but the actual scored_cases*.js files are NOT in the hash list — only the case_pack_N_corrected.js aliases appear. This is a partial-functionality issue: hashing works, but case-item counting is broken.
